name: split-diff
description: 对比双列：中缝发丝线 + 左右列按序入场（之前/之后，旧/新）
css: #tpl-split-diff { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .sd-title { font-size: 3.6vh; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 4vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .sd-cols { display: flex; gap: 5vw; position: relative; } .sd-col { flex: 1; opacity: 0; } .sd-sep { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -2vh; bottom: -2vh; width: 2px; background: currentColor; opacity: .3; transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: top center; } .sd-col h3 { font-size: 2.9vh; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 2vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .sd-col li { font-size: 2.1vh; line-height: 1.6; margin: 1.2vh 0; list-style: none; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); opacity: .85; }
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .sd-sep", { scaleY: 0 }, { scaleY: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, {start} + 0.15);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .sd-col:first-child", { opacity: 0, x: -40 }, { opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, {start} + 0.4);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .sd-col:last-child", { opacity: 0, x: 40 }, { opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out" }, {start} + 0.62);
